creator: Alexander Terp
description: Found 2026-11-05 recording Claude Code 2.1.318's 'Waiting for 1 background agent to finish' screen (d0b60f46 and the commits before it read that screen as idle with a readable prompt). The parent's Stop hook ran at 15:22:57.244 UTC; the background agent's PostToolUse, with a nonempty agent_id, ran at 15:22:58.188 UTC; and the parent's pane read working at 15:22:59 despite the Waiting line, because the hooks adapter's report outranks the screen. So a wake to that pane still waits until the background agent's turn ends. Both probe traces are in corpus as background-hooks.jsonl, labeled by probe; see docs/observations for 2.1.318. Decide whether a hook carrying agent_id should report for the parent at all. Likely also behind older tooling feedback about integrators waiting on background agents reading working (a_2lUBzmpNB, a_2o5tCfSnl).
title: A Claude Code background agent's PostToolUse reads its idle parent as working
